prose: A Latent Space podcast with Dyna Robotics chief scientist Jason Ma about Dyna-2, a world-action model pre-trained on one million hours of human video that claims new scaling laws across four orders of magnitude of human data, and Dyna-2.1, a physical agent with semi-humanoid hardware that handles super long-horizon whole-body workflows. A live demo of the Taku robot is included. Basis: the introduction of the episode page.
highlights: Dyna-2: world-action model trained on one million hours of human video.
Dyna-2.1: semi-humanoid physical agent for ultra-long workflows.
Claims scaling laws on human data over four orders of magnitude.
